sources.summary: The Abejas Sports and Recreation Center in Tijuana explores the role architecture can play in improving everyday life in underserved areas. Developed within a neighborhood shaped by rapid urban growth and limited access to quality public infrastructure, the project introduces a space dedicated to sports, recreation, and community activity.
